other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Assam
Applicant must have a recognition proof certificate
Applicant must have outstanding contributions in Music, Dance, Fine Arts, Puppetry, Musk making, Mobile Theatre, Amateur Theatre or Films
Indigent families of artists with outstanding contributions are eligible
benefits_summary: Provides monthly pensions of ₹8,000 for artists and ₹4,000 for families, and one‑time grants of ₹50,000 under two separate schemes.
